summary: Attendance Entry/Exit Tracking and Teacher Reports - ALL TESTS PASSED. Backend: 10/10 tests passed for QR history role filter, teacher reports endpoint, mark-entry endpoint, and student/teacher attendance endpoints. Frontend: All UI elements verified including 3-section layout, Reportes Profesores button, teacher report generation with summary cards and table, and QR scanner role filter badges (EST/PROF).
passed_tests: GET /api/attendance/qr/history returns history with role field (student/teacher)
GET /api/attendance/qr/history?role=student filters to only student records
GET /api/attendance/qr/history?role=teacher filters to only teacher records
GET /api/attendance/reports/teachers endpoint exists and returns summary/report data
GET /api/attendance/reports/teachers accepts start_date/end_date filters
POST /api/attendance/mark-entry stores entry_time, entry_method, check_in_time fields
POST /api/attendance/qr/scan validates QR token format
GET /api/attendance/reports/students endpoint exists and returns data
GET /api/attendance/students returns student list with attendance
GET /api/attendance/teachers returns teacher list with attendance
Attendance page loads with 3 section cards (Estudiantes, Profesores, Reportes)
Reportes section has 2 buttons: 'Reportes Estudiantes' (data-testid=btn-reports-students)
Reportes section has 2 buttons: 'Reportes Profesores' (data-testid=btn-reports-teachers)
Clicking 'Reportes Profesores' opens TeacherReportsTab (data-testid=teacher-reports-tab)
Teacher report view has date filters (data-testid=teacher-report-start-date, teacher-report-end-date)
Teacher report view has 'Generar Reporte' button (data-testid=teacher-report-generate)
Teacher report generates correctly with summary cards (Total, Presentes, Tardanzas, Ausentes, Justificados)
Teacher report shows table with teacher details and attendance rate
QR scanner from Students section loads correctly
QR scanner from Teachers section loads correctly
QR history shows role badges - 'EST' for students, 'PROF' for teachers
critical_code_review_comments: Backend QR scan response correctly includes 'action' field (entry/exit/already_both/already_entry/already_exit/no_entry) as documented
Backend mark-entry endpoint correctly stores entry_time (ISO timestamp), entry_method ('manual' or 'qr'), and check_in_time (HH:MM format)
Backend QR history endpoint correctly filters by role parameter - uses separate collections for students (student_attendance) and teachers (attendances with type='teacher')
Frontend AttendancePage.jsx correctly passes roleFilter prop (scanContext) to QRScannerTab based on which section was clicked ('student' or 'teacher')
QRScannerTab.jsx correctly uses roleFilter in API call: /api/attendance/qr/history?role=${roleFilter}
QR history display shows role badges: 'Prof' for teachers (bg-indigo-100 text-indigo-600) and 'Est' for students (bg-blue-100 text-blue-600)
context_for_next_testing_agent: Attendance module entry/exit tracking fully working. QR scan returns 'action' field indicating entry/exit/already_both states. QR history API supports ?role=student or ?role=teacher filter. Teacher reports endpoint at /api/attendance/reports/teachers returns summary and per-teacher breakdown. Frontend shows 3 sections on Attendance home: Estudiantes (blue), Profesores (purple), Reportes (amber). The Reportes section has 2 buttons for student and teacher reports. QR scanner history displays role badges (EST/PROF) correctly based on the section the user navigated from.
